title: Johnny and Joe Lindsay
summary: Morris recalls trombonist Johnny and drummer Joe Lindsay, brothers who could not get along; the tape is nearly out.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What about Johnny Lindsay? Where was he from?
Johnny Lindsay from uptown. Johnny Lindsay, Joe Lindsay. Now, Johnny Lindsay used to play trombone. You sure know him all right. You keep up with him better than me.
Is he uptown or across the river? Where did he come from?

He come from uptown. Uptown. That way. And Joe Lindsay used to play drum. Johnny Lindsay on trombone, Joe Lindsay on drum. And then after Johnny Lindsay, I believe, he went on bass. And after he died, I believe.
I asked Joe if they were related and he said no.
He had eight brothers. They're brothers. Johnny.
Well, let's see. Who was the guitar player?
One of them played guitar and their father played guitar. Herbert played.
Violin. Herbert. Herbert, yeah. Herbert Lindsay played violin.

Yeah. I know they had some brothers of them all right. Yeah. But Johnny Lindsay and Joe Lindsay, them was brothers. Lest they must have just played off brothers or something. Because they both used to play in the same band. They couldn't get along together.
Mm-mm. Always be some humbuck with one of them.
I was just about out of tape. If there's any other question, you can take it out of tape.
